d.g: Any of several arboreal monkeys, of the genus Cacajao, from the Amazon basin.

uakari.e: Borrowed from Brazilian Portuguese uacari, borrowed from Nheengatu wakarí, possibly from Old Tupi akaka'i.

d.g: The daughter of Scáthach and later the lover of Cúchulainn (after a duel with Cochar Crufe).
Title of a person who holds the office of President of Ireland.
The head of state of Ireland; the Irish president.
Uaru amphiacanthoides, a species of cichlid native to South America where it occurs in clear streams of the Amazon Basin.

uaru.e: Probably borrowed from taxonomic name Uaru.
